title: Where can you fly direct from Glasgow Airport?
author: Brogan
intro: Glasgow has a strong winter line-up for 2026/27, from Jet2's winter sun programme to new flights to Tromsø, Kraków and the Red Sea. Here's where you can fly direct, sorted by the kind of trip you want.
seo_title: Where can you fly direct from Glasgow Airport?
seo_description: Direct flights from Glasgow Airport for winter 2026/27: Jet2 winter sun and ski, new routes to Tromsø, Kraków and Hurghada, plus Dubai and summer routes.

sections.heading: Glasgow at a glance
sections.text:
Glasgow Airport is Scotland's main holiday airport. Jet2 and easyJet both have bases there and run most of the leisure flights, TUI flies holiday routes including long-haul, Emirates flies to Dubai, and KLM connects through Amsterdam.

Routes and timetables change every season. We checked this list in October 2026, but always check the airline's current schedule before planning around a flight.

sections.heading: Winter sun with Jet2
sections.text:
Jet2's winter 2026/27 programme from Glasgow covers 14 sunny destinations:

- **The Canaries:** [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote), [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) and [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura), the warmest places in Europe in winter.
- **[Madeira](/destinations/madeira)**, for mild weather and walking.
- **Spain and Portugal:** [Malaga](/destinations/malaga), Alicante, [Palma](/destinations/mallorca) and Faro.
- **[Paphos](/destinations/paphos)** in Cyprus and **[Malta](/destinations/malta)**.
- **[Antalya](/destinations/antalya)** in Turkey.
- **Morocco:** [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) and Agadir.

Jet2 has also added **Hurghada** in Egypt from Glasgow for winter, for guaranteed Red Sea sunshine. The Canaries take around four and a half hours from Scotland. Our [November](/destinations/where-to-go-in-november) and [January](/destinations/where-to-go-in-january) pages compare winter temperatures.

sections.heading: Snow, skiing and the northern lights
sections.text:
- **[Tromsø](/destinations/tromso):** Norwegian starts flying from Glasgow on 11 December 2026, twice a week through the winter. It's one of the best places in Europe to see the northern lights, and a much easier trip from Scotland without changing planes.
- **Geneva:** Jet2 flies weekly on Saturdays from 12 December 2026 for its ski programme, which reaches [Chamonix](/destinations/chamonix), [Verbier](/destinations/verbier) and the big French resorts. Our guide to the [best ski resorts for a weekend](/blog/best-ski-resorts-for-a-weekend-from-the-uk) covers the ones closest to the airport.

If you're weighing up the Arctic options, see our comparison of [Tromsø or Rovaniemi](/blog/tromso-or-rovaniemi).

sections.heading: City breaks and Christmas markets
sections.text:
EasyJet runs most of Glasgow's city routes. New for this winter is **[Kraków](/destinations/krakow)**, from 13 November 2026, on Mondays and Fridays, just in time for its Christmas market.

Other city choices from Glasgow include [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam) with KLM and easyJet, plus Spanish and Portuguese cities with easyJet and Jet2. If you want a city break with a Christmas market, our pick of the [best Christmas markets in Europe](/blog/best-christmas-markets-in-europe) helps you choose, and [Vienna or Prague](/blog/vienna-or-prague-at-christmas) compares two of the most popular.

sections.heading: Long-haul from Glasgow
sections.text:
Glasgow has a small but useful long-haul list:

- **[Dubai](/destinations/dubai):** Emirates flies year-round, around 7 hours, with connections across Asia, Africa and Australia.
- **[Cancún](/destinations/cancun):** TUI's longest route from Glasgow, at nearly 10 hours, for Caribbean beaches in Mexico.
- **North America in summer:** in summer 2026, United flew daily to Newark for [New York](/destinations/new-york), from May to September, and WestJet returned with four flights a week to [Toronto](/destinations/toronto). Check whether they're running again for summer 2027 before you plan.

For more transatlantic choice, Edinburgh has a bigger list. Our guide to [where you can fly direct from Edinburgh](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-edinburgh-airport) covers it.

sections.heading: Summer holidays
sections.text:
In summer, the Jet2, easyJet and TUI networks grow to cover most of the Mediterranean: Spain and the Balearics, Portugal, Greece and its islands, Turkey, Cyprus, Croatia and more. Jet2 has added weekly flights to Kos for summer 2026.

For Greek islands without direct flights from Scotland, fly to a bigger island and take a ferry. Our guide to [alternatives to Santorini](/blog/alternatives-to-santorini) has ideas.

sections.heading: Getting to Glasgow Airport
sections.text:
The airport is about 8 miles west of the city centre, near Paisley:

- **Bus:** the Glasgow Airport Express runs from the city centre in around 25 minutes, around the clock, which helps for early flights.
- **Train:** there's no rail link to the terminal. The nearest station is Paisley Gilmour Street, a short bus or taxi ride away.
- **Car:** the airport is just off the M8. There's a charge to use the drop-off zone, so check current prices before you go.

Still choosing? Put the Glasgow routes you like on a shared somewhere.party list and let everyone vote.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Glasgow to Tromsø?
faqs.answer: Yes. Norwegian flies twice a week from Glasgow to Tromsø from 11 December 2026.

faqs.question: Where can you fly from Glasgow for winter sun?
faqs.answer: Jet2 flies to the Canaries, Madeira, southern Spain, the Algarve, Cyprus, Malta, Antalya and Morocco, and has added Hurghada in Egypt for winter 2026/27.

faqs.question: Does Glasgow Airport have flights to the USA?
faqs.answer: In summer 2026, United flew daily to Newark from May to September. Check whether it returns for summer 2027. Year-round long-haul flights from Glasgow go to Dubai with Emirates.

faqs.question: Can you ski from Glasgow Airport?
faqs.answer: Jet2 flies weekly to Geneva on Saturdays from 12 December 2026, which reaches many French and Swiss ski resorts.

faqs.question: Is there a train to Glasgow Airport?
faqs.answer: No. The nearest station is Paisley Gilmour Street. Most people take the Glasgow Airport Express bus from the city centre.
